title: Number of Ways to Rearrange Sticks With K Sticks Visible
goal: Count stick permutations with exactly k visible sticks from the left.
strategy: Insert the shortest stick into an order of the others. At the front it adds one visible stick; each other insertion position leaves visibility unchanged.
